title: Registration conditions — Wildstrubel by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Wildstrubel by UTMB
claims: Registration for 2027 opens on 17 November 2026 at 10:00 Swiss time for runners with a valid UTMB Index and on 19 November 2026 at 10:00 for everyone, first come first served, with no lottery and no waiting list.
The Wild 110 entry fee is CHF 220–275 plus an 8% administration fee; the minimum age is 18 (born in 2008 or earlier).
The fee includes the bib, timing, participant gifts, aid-station access, drop-bag transport for Wild 110, medical assistance and after-race services.
The page header says '09–12 September 2027', while the race page gives a Friday 10 September 2027 start and the races page lists 10–12 September.
The page calls the 55 km race 'Wild 50', while the races page and race page call it 'Wild 55'.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接抓取并读取 2027 报名条件页。
